name: Nova
tagline: The Future of Learning for Class 9 & 10 🚀
description: Nova is a foundational learning platform designed exclusively for Class 9 and 10 students. It combines immersive 3D models (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Math), interactive quizzes, and deep performance analysis to make complex concepts simple, engaging, and future-ready.
keyFeatures: Conceptual clarity for board exam readiness

name: Curio
description: Curio is a specialized learning platform crafted for Class 11 and 12 science students. It blends immersive 3D models, interactive quizzes, and in-depth performance analysis to simplify complex scientific concepts and prepare learners for NEET, JEE, and board exams.
targetAudience: Class 11 & 12 Science Students (NEP/NEET/JEE aspirants), Teachers, Parents
keyFeatures: Immersive 3D Science Models (Molecules, Reactions, Anatomy, Physics)
Adaptive quizzes aligned to competitive exam patterns (NEET, JEE)
AI Chat Bot and AI Voice Assistant (Pro plan)

name: Vibe
tagline: Connecting Students and Startups Through Internships 💼
description: Vibe is an internship provider platform designed to bridge the gap between students and the industry. It connects Class 11, 12, and higher education learners with SMEs and startups for real-world experience and career readiness.
targetAudience: Students (Class 11, 12, Higher Ed), Startups, SMEs, and Educational Institutions
keyFeatures: Industry Access portal for SMEs and Startups to post and manage internships
Practical Skill Development aligned with academics
